responsibility: Supplies the declarative extension-definition table for CORE-V vendor ISA extensions within the RISC-V backend’s extension catalog. Through `DEFINE_RISCV_EXT` entries it records each CORE-V extension’s canonical name, full description string, supported versions, flag-group assignment, and feature-bit placeholders, so generator programs and option/documentation machinery can recognize CORE-V subextensions such as XCVALU, XCVELW, XCVMAC, and XCVSIMD alongside the standard RISC-V extension set.
